lines: Did you finally open your eyes?
Then why don’t you even meet my gaze?
You scold, “You’re late.”
Even so, I’ve rushed forward as far as I could.
My heart has overtaken my body.
Just your hair and those eyes make my chest ache.
I inhale the same moment and don’t want to let it go.
I am drawn to that voice I have known since ancient times.
For the first time in my life, what should I say?
Since your far‑past life, I have begun searching for you.
I came aiming at that clumsy way you laugh.
Even if you lose everything and become shattered into pieces,
I won’t hesitate any more; I’ll start searching again from the beginning.
Rather, shall we start the universe anew from zero?
I wonder where to begin.
The story that unfolded while you slept.
I have come to tell a story spanning billions of light‑years.
Yet now, when that form is mirrored in my eyes,
I want to frolic, colliding with a you even you don’t know.
I want to love even your undying pain.
We met at the edge of countless galaxies.
How should I hold that hand without breaking it?
Since your far‑past life, I have begun searching for you.
I came aiming at that noisy voice and its tears.
Who could say they will stop us on the eve of such a revolution?
I won’t hesitate; I’ll plant a flag in your heart.
You stole the way to give up from me.
